atoms.sound: ssml: Degrees Celsius is a unit used to measure temperature.
atoms.b: ((++°C --£)) is a unit used to measure temperature.

atoms.sound: ssml: The tool used to measure temperature is called a <break time='500ms'/>.
atoms.b: The tool used to measure temperature is called a ((--scale ++thermometer)).
atoms.finishSound: The tool used to measure temperature is called a thermometer.

atoms.sound: ssml: When the temperature is hotter, the liquid in the thermometer goes <break time='500ms'/>.
atoms.b: When the temperature is hotter, the liquid in the thermometer goes ((++up --left)).
atoms.finishSound: When the temperature is hotter, the liquid in the thermometer goes up.

atoms.sound: ssml: When the temperature is <break time='500ms'/>, the liquid goes down.
atoms.b: When the temperature is ((++colder --louder)), the liquid goes down.
atoms.finishSound: When the temperature is colder, the liquid goes down.

atoms.a: Which thermometer would you use to measure the temperature of machinery?
Which thermometer would you use if you are feeling unwell?

instruction.text: Listen to the temperature below and Select the correct point on the thermometer scale.

wrong.text: Look at where the liquid stops on the scale and Select the correct point.
wrong.sound: Look at where the liquid stops on the scale and Select the correct point.

instruction.text: Adjust the thermometer by selecting the hotter and colder buttons. When the thermometer reaches the temperature below, select enough.

atoms.finishSound: The thermometer now shows 35 degrees Celsius.
